texts.academy_hint: Isifundo esifushane sivuleka eduze kwesikrini esisifundisayo.
texts.auto_low_stock_reorder: Bhala i-oda kabusha uma isitoko siphansi
texts.auto_reorder_one_tap: I-oda kabusha ngokuthepha kanye kumhlinzeki wokugcina
texts.auto_sync_retry: Thumela izinto ezilindile uma ukuxhumana sekubuyile
texts.automations_intro: Konke okuzenzakalelayo kubhalwe lapha nokuthi kwenzani, izinga lako nesicishi sako. Akukho okuhambisa imali, okushintsha iphasiwedi noma okwenza ngaphezu kwezinga lako.
texts.data_sharing_body: Umhlinzeki ubona ukuthi imikhiqizo yakhe ithengiswa kanjani esitolo sakho kuphela uma ukhetha ukwabelana. Imvume eyodwa ngomhlinzeki ngamunye, ehoxiseka noma nini. Idatha yakho ayisoze yathengiswa.
texts.day_close_body: Ukuthengisa okungu-{sales}, {total}. Ukheshi olindelekile edroyini {cash}. Kuqinisekisiwe {confirmed}, kulindile {waiting}.
texts.details_secure: Imininingwane iboniswa ngumkhiphi onelayisensi ngemva kokuhlola okusha, isikhathi esifushane, hhayi neze ngaphandle kokuxhumana.
texts.failed_try_again: Uzakwethu wenqabile. Akukho okuthathiwe. Zama enye indlela.
texts.float_forecast: Imali yokusebenza esele cishe ezinsuku ezingu-{days} ngejubane elijwayelekile (isilinganiso)
texts.float_read_live: Kufundwa bukhoma kozakwethu. I-LynkOmni ayisoze yagcina imali yakho yokusebenza.
texts.freeze_requested: Ukumiswa kucelwe. Kuzoboniswa njengokumisiwe kuphela uma umkhiphi eqinisekisa.
texts.group_reached: Iqembu lifinyelele. Isitolo ngasinye sikhokhela umhlinzeki ingxenye yaso.
texts.internet_help: Susa uphawu ukuze usebenze ungaxhunyiwe: amaqiniso alondolozwa njengokusemugqeni futhi athunyelwe kamuva. Amasevisi e-ejenti, okuqoqa imali nozakwethu awaqali neze ungaxhunyiwe.
texts.joined: Ujoyinile. Ukhokhela umhlinzeki ingxenye yakho kuphela uma iqembu lifinyelela.
texts.laptop_note: Lokhu ukubuka komnikazi esipheqululini. Ukuthengisa nokheshi kusebenza kuphela edivayisini ebhalisiwe.
texts.locale_card: Izwe, ulimi, imali nendawo yesikhathi kuvela ephaketheni lezwe lakho. Shintsha noma yikuphi ngokuthepha kanye.
texts.mesh_no_money: I-LynkMesh ithwala idatha, hhayi imali, futhi ayikhokhisi. U-B akakwazi ukufunda noma ukushintsha akuthwalayo.
texts.needs_registered_device: Ukuthengisa, ukheshi, amashifu namasevisi e-ejenti kusebenza kuphela edivayisini ebhaliselwe ibhizinisi.
texts.never_before_confirmed: Ungalokothi unikeze ukheshi ngaphambi kokuthi uzakwethu aqinisekise.
texts.not_proof: Umlayezo wombhalo noma isithombe-skrini akubona ubufakazi benkokhelo. Kubalwa okuqinisekisiwe kuphela.
texts.nothing_understood: Akukho okufanayo. Zama futhi noma uthephe imikhiqizo.
texts.online_only: Amasevisi e-ejenti, okuqoqa imali nozakwethu adinga ukuxhumana. Akukho okufakwa emugqeni.
texts.placeholder_limits: Imikhawulo namanani okwesikhashana kuze kusayinwe umkhiphi.
texts.practice_mode_help: Ikhophi yokuqeqesha ephawulwe ngokucacile. Akukho akubhalayo okungokwangempela futhi akukho okuvumelaniswayo.
texts.provider_declines_help: Uzakwethu wokuhlola uphendula ngokuthi Kwehlulekile esikhundleni sokuthi Kuqinisekisiwe.
texts.real_user_help: Libonisa izwe elikhethiwe njengoba umhwebi walapho elibona namuhla: kusebenza kuphela lokho okumbozwa nguzakwethu onelayisensi osayiniwe; okunye kubonisa "Kuyeza ezweni lakho maduze".
texts.referred: Kudluliselwe kozakwethu. Uzakwethu uyanquma futhi azise ikhasimende.
texts.relay_body: Le divayisi ayinakho ukuxhumana. Idivayisi ye-LynkOmni eseduze ithwala iqoqo elivaliwe iliyise efwini. Akukho okuboniswa njengokwamukelwe kuze kube ifu likwamukele.
texts.sandbox_note: Idatha yesibonelo, ozakwethu bokuhlola, imali yokuhlola kuphela. Akukabuyekezwa ngumklami.
texts.second_currency: Cishe {amount} (isilinganiso ngenani lanamuhla; ukuthengisa kuhlala ku-{currency})
texts.setup_done_in: Kusethwa ngaphansi kwemizuzu emibili. Ukuthengisa kokuqala ngomzuzu.
texts.shop_qr_help: Amakhasimende askena le khodi ukuze avule ikhasi lesitolo sakho futhi akhokhe.
texts.start_group_pro: Ukuqala iqembu kudinga i-Pro noma i-Max.
texts.voice_hint: Sho izinto, isibonelo "izikhwama ezimbili zelayisi, insipho eyodwa". Uyaqinisekisa ngaphambi kokuthi ukuthengisa kulondolozwe.
texts.why_cash_difference_flag: Ukubalwa kukakheshi kwehlukile kulokho ithili ebikulindele. Akukho okuvinjiwe.
texts.why_chat_routing: Umlayezo uye kumuntu ophethe lolu hlobo lombuzo.
texts.why_chat_suggested_replies: Ikhasimende libhalile; kuphakanyiswe izimpendulo ngolimi lwalo ukuze umuntu akhethe.
texts.why_chat_summary: Ucele isifinyezo; izibalo zihlala zibonakala futhi isifinyezo siphawuliwe.
texts.why_commission_match: Isitatimende sozakwethu sifikile futhi saqhathaniswa umugqa nomugqa; umehluko ngamunye uphawuliwe.
texts.why_day_close_prepare: Isikhathi sokuvala: ukuthengisa, ukheshi olindelekile edroyini, izinto eziphelayo nanoma yini engajwayelekile, emlayezweni owodwa.
texts.why_delivery_auto_request: Umthetho wakho ubhuke uzakwethu oshibhile kakhulu we-oda elikhokhelwe. Ungakuhlehlisa imizuzu emihlanu.
texts.why_device_health: Idivayisi ebhalisiwe inohlelo oludala, ibhethri eliphansi, isikhala esincane noma ayibonwanga izinsuku eziningi.
texts.why_expiry_alert: Iqoqo liphelelwa yisikhathi kungakapheli isonto; kubhalwe isaphulelo noma ukulahlwa.
texts.why_kitchen_routing: I-oda letafula lifike esikrinini sasekhishini, noma kuphrinta ohlelweni lwe-Free.
texts.why_low_float_warning: Imali yakho yokusebenza kozakwethu yehle ngaphansi kwengxenye eyodwa kweziyisihlanu zosuku olujwayelekile.
texts.why_low_stock_reorder: Isitoko sifinyelele ezingeni le-oda kabusha; kubhalwe ukuthenga ukuze ukuqinisekise.
texts.why_negative_stock_flag: Ukuthengisa kwehlise isitoko ngaphansi kweqanda ungaxhunyiwe. Ukuthengisa akuzange kuvinjwe; bala umkhiqizo.
texts.why_product_from_photo: Uthathe isithombe; i-LynkAssist ibhale igama, intengo nesigaba. Akukho okulondolozwayo uze uqinisekise.
texts.why_receipt_delivery: Irisidi ithunyelwe ngomgudu okhethwe yikhasimende, ngaphakathi kohlelo lwakho.
texts.why_reorder_one_tap: Wake wamukela lo mkhiqizo; ukuthepha kanye kuwuoda kabusha kumhlinzeki ofanayo ngemva kokuqinisekisa.
texts.why_setup_autofill: Kudalwe ibhizinisi; i-LynkAssist ibhale iphrofayela yalo isuka ephaketheni lezwe ukuze uyiqinisekise.
texts.why_staff_pin_lock: Akuthintwanga imizuzu emibili; ukhiye we-PIN wabasebenzi usebenzile.
texts.why_sync_retry: Ukuxhumana kubuyile; ukuthengisa nezinkokhelo kuthunyelwe kuqala, izithombe ekugcineni.
